description: A Markov Decision Process Approach to Delimiting Hinterlands Under Climate-Induced Impacts provides an ISA-MDP replication package for soybean export routing under climate-dependent crop yields, corridor capacity and waterway navigability. The provider is Veloso, Ronaldo ; Mota, Daniel. Geographical and temporal coverage: The model covers 128 producing municipalities in Mato Grosso, Brazil, and nine export corridors; the page identifies a finite-horizon decision process. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
